reason: Thirty-six dollars for a tinted balm from a brand I've never heard of, with not a single review, from an Instagram ad? I've bought these color-changing balms before and they all ended up drying my lips by lunchtime, so I'll pass. I can afford it, I just don't pay full price for a gamble.
objection: It will probably dry my lips like the others, and with no reviews there's nobody my age saying it doesn't. The guarantee sounds nice, but I'd still have to chase a small online company for a refund.
would_change_my_mind: A real deal like buy-one-get-one, plus honest reviews from women over 60 saying it stays moisturizing through the day and doesn't bleed into the lines.
